name: Broccoli Cheddar Soup
steps: Cut broccoli into small florets and dice the stalk; grate carrot and chop onion finely.
Soften onion in butter, stir in flour and cook briefly until the raw flour smell fades.
Whisk in stock and milk gradually; add broccoli and carrot and simmer until the vegetables are tender.
Reduce the heat, blend a small portion if desired, then stir in grated vegetarian cheddar until melted; season without boiling.
tips: Choose cheddar made with microbial or vegetarian rennet, and add it off the boil to keep the soup smooth.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
